name: Build Your Own Shell
description: Implement a Unix-like shell with command execution, piping, and built-in commands.
readme:
# Build Your Own Shell

Implement a minimal Unix shell in Rust.

## Stages

1. Basic REPL: Read input, parse commands, execute external programs
2. Built-ins: Implement cd, exit, echo, type
3. Piping: Support | to chain commands
4. Redirection: Support > and < for file I/O
5. Job Control: Background processes with &

## Getting Started

Each stage builds on the previous one. Start with stage 1 and work your way up.

Run tests with cargo test after implementing each stage.
